claims.text: Both 123.235.32.19 and 52.80.34.196 show a pattern of repeated failed login attempts, with each attempt being quickly followed by a disconnect.
However, the nature of these attempts differs between the two IP addresses.
123.235.32.19 consistently attempts to log in as the root user, while 52.80.34.196 attempts to log in as various invalid users, including 'test9', 'test', and 'matlab'.
This suggests that 52.80.34.196 may be attempting to brute-force its way into the system by trying a variety of usernames, whereas 123.235.32.19 is targeting a specific account.
Furthermore, the repeated failed login attempts from 123.235.32.19 span a short period of time, specifically from 07:32:27 to 07:34:33, indicating a burst of activity.
In contrast, the attempts from 52.80.34.196 are spread out over a longer period, from 07:07:38 to 10:21:09, with some gaps in between.
This suggests that 123.235.32.19 is the more anomalous attacker, as its behavior is more concentrated and intense.
